description: This file defines the PasswordStrengthValidation class in the OrangeHRM project, responsible for evaluating the strength of user passwords using the Zxcvbn library. It includes constants for different strength levels and a method to assess password strength based on user credentials.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthValidation
classes.description: Class for validating the strength of passwords using the Zxcvbn library within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: checkPasswordStrength
methods.description: Evaluates the strength of a user's password and returns a corresponding constant indicating the strength level.
